steps.description:
Write a program to save a contact list using a dictionary. The program will loop repeatedly, asking the user to select from the following menu: [1] Add [2] Show all

If [1] is selected, the program will ask the user to enter a name followed by the contact which can be an email or a phone number. The program will then add it to the dictionary. If the name already exists (assume case sensitive, i.e. "Alan" is not equal to "alan"), the contact will be overwritten.

If [2] is selected, the program will display all the contacts one by one in the format name : contact.

The program will return to the main menu after each operation. You need to create at least one function for each menu task.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Test Input 1 Asher Catherine Asher@email.com 2 1 Asher 11112222 1 Asher Catherine 99990000 2

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the example below: [1] Add [2] Show all Selection: 1 Enter name: Asher Catherine Enter contact: Asher@email.com

[1] Add [2] Show all Selection: 2 Asher Catherine : Asher@email.com

[1] Add [2] Show all Selection: 1 Enter name: Asher Enter contact: 11112222

[1] Add [2] Show all Selection: 1 Enter name: Asher Catherine Enter contact: 99990000

[1] Add [2] Show all Selection: 2 Asher Catherine : 99990000 Ash : 11112222

Write a program to save a contact list using a dictionary. The program will loop repeatedly, asking the user to select from the following menu: [1] Add [2] Delete [3] Show all

If [1] is selected, the program will ask the user to enter a name followed by the contact which can be an email or a phone number. The program will then add it to the dictionary. If the name already exists (assume case sensitive, i.e. "Alan" is not equal to "alan"), the contact will be overwritten.

If [2] is selected, the program will ask the user to enter a name. If the name exists (case sensitive, i.e. "Alan" is not equal to "alan"), the program will delete the contact from the dictionary and display "Contact deleted". Otherwise, it will display "Contact not found" and return to the menu.

If [3] is selected, the program will display all the contacts one by one in the format name : contact.

The program will return to the main menu after each operation. You need to create at least one function for each menu task.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Test Input 1 Ash Ash@email.com 3 1 Ash ashley@email.com 1 Minto Ashley 11112222 4 2 ASH 2 Ash 4

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the example below:

[1] Add [2] Delete [3] Show all Selection: 1 Enter name: Ash Enter contact: Ash@email.com

[1] Add [2] Delete [3] Show all Selection: 3 Ash : Ash@email.com

[1] Add [2] Delete [3] Show all Selection: 1 Enter name: Minto Ashley Enter contact: 11112222

Write a program to save a contact list using dictionary. The program will loop repeatedly, asking the user to select from the following menu: [1] Add [2] Delete [3] Search [4] Show all

If [1] is selected, the program will ask the user to enter a name followed by the contact which can be an email or a phone number. The program will then add it to the dictionary. If the name already exists (assume case sensitive, i.e. "Alan" is not equal to "alan"), the contact will be overwritten.

If [2] is selected, the program will ask the user to enter a name. If the name exists (case sensitive, i.e. "Alan" is not equal to "alan"), the program will delete the contact from the dictionary and display "Contact deleted". Otherwise, it will display "Contact not found" and return to the menu.

If [3] is selected, the pogram will ask the user to enter a search string. If the search string exists in any part of the dictionary, all those contacts will be listed (eg. If user searches "Tim" and there exists "Timothy : 12345678" and "George : georgetim@email.com", both the contacts will be displayed. Otherwise, it will display "Contact not found" and return to the main menu. While checking for existence, ignore the letter case, e.g. "ALAN" matches to "alan".

If [4] is selected, the program will display all the contacts one by one in the format name : contact. The program will return to the main menu after each operation. You need to create at least one function for each menu task.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.
